briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race ahead as compute shortages intensify global AI competition

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid record funding, while regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous agents. Multi-agent systems show rapid capability jumps but expose new attack surfaces.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with advanced tool use; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus; Google pushed Gemini 3; DeepSeek R2 closed capability gap with Western models; xAI launched Grok-3.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New red-team findings highlight agent-to-agent exploits.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA H200 shipments ramp; Microsoft and Google announce new 100k GPU clusters; TSMC reports AI chip demand exceeding supply forecasts through 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards emerge before a major cross-model security incident occurs?
